[center][b]WHAT IS THIS MESS?[/b][/center]

Have you put an embarrassing amount of hours into Stardew Valley? Need something to spice up the yellowing relationship? Like an uglier shade of yellow? Yellow is an odd word. Yellow. Think about it. Y-E-L-L-O-W.  

I've got a lil something-something to help you out. And by "something-something" I mean a visual overhaul that includes:

-Every texture (that I could find) has been desaturated and tweaked to look a bit more dreary, including UI and bachelor/ette events.

-Portraits/sprites have been altered to varying degrees. Some got pimples, others got a race change, one may or may not resemble Donald Trump.

-Changed animal coloring and a few breeds. White cow > Brahmin, Rabbit > Lop Bunny, Goat > Same Goat But With Slightly Longer Horns, Horse >    Draft Horse

-Made the farm buildings look run down and overgrown

-Wooden fence is now a barbed wire fence

-Replaced some furniture with stuff stolen from townspeople


[center][img]http://i.imgur.com/lWCgbM2.png?5[/img][/center]


[b][center] MAKE BACKUPS, IM JUST AN IDIOT WITH PHOTOSHOP [/center][/b]


To Install:
1. Download file
2. Unzip
3. Copy "Content" folder 
4. Paste into Stardew Valley folder (typically found in  \Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley)
5. Agree to merge/replace files


To Uninstall:
- Copy and paste your backups into your Stardew Valley folder.
- You can also go to your Steam library > right click "Stardew Valley" > Properties > Local Files > Verify Integrity of Game Cache

[color=red]I haven't tested this much, so PLEASE PLEASE let me know if you find a bug or some dumb mistake and I'll try to fix it.[/color]
